```{r}
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(123)
y1 <- 727   
y2 <- 580   
y3 <- 136   
n  <- y1 + y2 + y3 
alpha_post <- c(y1 + 1, y2 + 1, y3 + 1)
alpha_sum <- sum(alpha_post)
post_mean <- alpha_post / alpha_sum
```


#(2)
```{r}
log_posterior <- function(theta1, theta2) {
  theta3 <- 1 - theta1 - theta2
  if (theta1 <= 0 | theta2 <= 0 | theta3 <= 0) return(-Inf)
  (alpha_post[1]-1)*log(theta1) +
    (alpha_post[2]-1)*log(theta2) +
    (alpha_post[3]-1)*log(theta3)
}

metropolis <- function(n_iter = 50000, sigma = 0.01) {
  samples <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_iter, ncol = 2)
  
  theta_cur <- c(y1/n, y2/n)
  log_p_cur <- log_posterior(theta_cur[1], theta_cur[2])
  accept_count <- 0
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    theta_prop <- theta_cur + rnorm(2, 0, sigma)
    log_p_prop <- log_posterior(theta_prop[1], theta_prop[2])
    
    log_ratio <- log_p_prop - log_p_cur
    
    if (!is.na(log_ratio) && log(runif(1)) < log_ratio) {
      theta_cur  <- theta_prop
      log_p_cur  <- log_p_prop
      accept_count <- accept_count + 1
    }
    samples[i, ] <- theta_cur
  }
  
  accept_rate <- accept_count / n_iter
  return(list(
    samples = samples,
    accept_rate = accept_rate
  ))
}
```

```{r}
mcmc_result <- metropolis(n_iter = 51000, sigma = 0.012)

raw_samples <- mcmc_result$samples      
acc_rate <- mcmc_result$accept_rate   
samples     <- raw_samples[1001:51000, ]   
theta1_mcmc <- samples[, 1]
theta2_mcmc <- samples[, 2]
diff_mcmc   <- theta1_mcmc - theta2_mcmc
acc_rate
```
The accept_rate of this mcmc is 0.4126471


# (3)

```{r}
hist(theta1_mcmc, breaks=50, freq=FALSE, border="white",
     main="Theta 1 (Bush): MCMC vs True", xlab=expression(theta[1]))
x_val <- seq(0.4, 0.6, length.out=1000)
lines(x_val, dbeta(x_val, 728, 718), col="red", lwd=2)

hist(theta2_mcmc, breaks=50, freq=FALSE, border="white",
     main="Theta 2 (Dukakis): MCMC vs True", xlab=expression(theta[2]))
lines(x_val, dbeta(x_val, 581, 865), col="red", lwd=2)
```
The histograms of the Metropolis samples almost align with the theoretical marginal Beta density curves, which confirms that Metropolis algorithm has converged to the correct target posterior distribution.

# (4)
```{r}
prob_bush_wins <- mean(theta1_mcmc > theta2_mcmc)
print(paste("Probability Bush wins:", prob_bush_wins))
prob_margin_10 <- mean(diff_mcmc > 0.1)
print(paste("Probability margin > 0.1:", prob_margin_10))

prob_margin_20 <- mean(diff_mcmc > 0.2)
print(paste("Probability margin > 0.2:", prob_margin_20))
```
